title: MOT-UGC-YAPPER-01 — Production v6 · unbranded listicle ad
summary: FINAL v6: 5:38 vertical ad, 1080×1920/30fps, rendered in DaVinci Resolve. Exact 987-word script; ElevenLabs Michelle (female age50) and one continuous HeyGen Avatar V performance. Fourteen distinct Omni B-roll clips, six static overlays, 228 captions. No Motilli packaging/product cutouts or guarantee badge; two-gummy routine retained. Final MP4, Resolve project/timeline and SRT saved with the concept.

beats.script: I was two months into a GLP-1, dropping weight, and still waking up every morning feeling backed up and uncomfortable like nothing had moved.
beats.visual: Same car presenter, close eye-level frame; direct eye contact.
beats.emotion: Recognition — identify the weight-loss/discomfort contradiction.
beats.note: Open immediately on I was; no title pre-roll. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice.

beats.script: Because I was dropping weight. The shot was actually working.

beats.script: But I felt like someone had filled my gut with concrete and forgotten about it. That heavy backed-up pressure that just sat there all day.

beats.emotion: Agitation — show why even a small dinner feels difficult.
beats.note: Cut on a few bites at dinner for 3s; return on And it did not matter, following actual wording. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice. Cover window 00:26.4–00:29.4; straight return to presenter.

beats.note: Cut on My jeans for 2s; return for leaving the dinner table early. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice. Cover window 00:33.6–00:35.6; straight return to presenter.

beats.emotion: Isolation — make waiting after meals tangible.
beats.note: Straight cut on stand in the kitchen; hold about 3s, then back. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice. Cover window 00:39.8–00:42.7; straight return to presenter.

beats.script: And I couldn't explain it to anyone without sounding like I was being dramatic.

beats.emotion: Empathy — vulnerability belongs on her face.
beats.note: Return before And I could not explain it, aligned to exact words. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice.

beats.emotion: Open loop — acknowledge experience without a fake comparison graphic.
beats.note: Hold face through Something was definitely still missing. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice.

beats.visual: Overhead evening desk: laptop with indistinct article layout, handwritten notes, mug and reading glasses; mature hand on trackpad.
beats.emotion: Search — show effort without inventing an authoritative quotation.
beats.note: Insert on thirty different articles for 3s; continuous narration. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice. Cover window 01:50.8–01:53.8; straight return to presenter.

beats.visual: Presenter introduces what she read.
beats.emotion: Discovery — bridge from search to explanation.
beats.note: Return before gastroenterologist; no fake doctor portrait or credentials. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice.

beats.script: He explained it like this.
beats.visual: Small natural reset before the explanation.
beats.emotion: Orientation — invite the viewer into a simple explanation.
beats.note: Brief hold on He explained it like this. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice.

beats.script: Your stomach is basically a muscle. It contracts, churns your food, and pushes everything forward. But GLP-1 medications slow those contractions down.
beats.visual: Single educational stomach cutaway; later motion is gentle wall contraction/churning, not a blocked valve.
beats.emotion: Mechanism — establish the organ and movement once.
beats.note: Cut on stomach is basically a muscle; cover about 4s, return or hold as aligned. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice. Cover window 02:05.2–02:09.2; straight return to presenter.

beats.script: Think of a river that suddenly slows to a trickle. Everything that was flowing through starts to back up behind it.
beats.visual: Overhead shallow river view: broad upstream pool feeding a narrow gentle trickle, a few floating leaves.
beats.emotion: Understanding — translate slowed flow into the script’s metaphor.
beats.note: Straight cut on Think of a river; hold 4s. A metaphor, never a clinical before/after. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice. Cover window 02:15.8–02:19.8; straight return to presenter.

beats.script: Food backs up. Waste backs up. Gas builds with nowhere to go. And all that pressure is what you're feeling every single day.
beats.visual: Flat gut-lumen schematic: contents and several gas pockets within a soft tube; no full torso or repeated stomach.
beats.emotion: Mechanism — give gas/pressure a separate visual vocabulary.
beats.note: Cut on Food backs up for 3s; return before all that pressure lands. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice. Cover window 02:22.4–02:25.4; straight return to presenter.

beats.script: It wasn't a diet problem. It wasn't something I was doing wrong. It was the gut slowdown.
beats.visual: Return to direct eye contact; slight release on It was the gut slowdown.
beats.emotion: Relief — remove self-blame and close the first loop.
beats.note: Hard return on It was not a diet problem, using the exact spoken words. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice.

beats.script: So now I knew what was causing it. But I still had no idea what actually addressed the slowdown itself.
beats.visual: Same presenter, curiosity rather than a sales pivot.
beats.emotion: Second loop — what addresses it?
beats.note: Hold the question through slowdown itself. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice.

beats.script: One night I was up late scrolling through a GLP-1 support group on Facebook. And a woman posted about what she'd been taking. She said she'd been backed up for months on Ozempic until she started using three specific ingredients together.
beats.visual: Flat illustrated social-group post card, clearly labeled Illustrative recreation; no phone video.
beats.emotion: Discovery — move from research to the peer account.
beats.note: Overlay on GLP-1 support group for 4s, then return; keep mouth and captions clear. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice. Cover window 02:45.7–02:49.7; straight return to presenter.

beats.script: First was apigenin from celery juice. She said it's been shown in research to activate the receptors in the gut wall that trigger those muscle contractions. The ones that actually push food through.
beats.visual: Distinct close view of celery stalks and juice; neutral ingredient image.
beats.emotion: Ingredient 1 — give an unfamiliar name a concrete anchor; no simulated proof.
beats.note: Overlay on apigenin from celery juice for 3s; return for the receptor statement. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice. Cover window 02:58.4–03:01.4; straight return to presenter.

beats.script: Second was chlorophyllin, a plant compound that's been studied clinically to bind gas-producing compounds before they get a chance to build pressure.
beats.visual: Dark-green ingredient sample with its existing chlorophyllin label, separate from celery.
beats.emotion: Ingredient 2 — visually separate the second ingredient without an efficacy animation.
beats.note: Overlay on Second for 3s; return for clinical wording. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice. Cover window 03:10.8–03:13.8; straight return to presenter.

beats.script: Third was a soluble prebiotic fiber. But she was specific about the type because the wrong kind can actually make the gas worse, not better.
beats.visual: Small fine powder portion beside mixed water, existing category image.
beats.emotion: Ingredient 3 — make the type distinction legible.
beats.note: Overlay on soluble prebiotic fiber for 3s; face for wrong kind qualifier. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice. Cover window 03:18.6–03:21.6; straight return to presenter.

beats.script: She said it was the only thing that had actually moved the needle. She'd been on the shot for a year and said people at her gym kept asking what she was doing differently.
beats.visual: Same presenter recounts the other woman’s experience.
beats.emotion: Peer story — retain the anecdote without creating false proof.
beats.note: Stay on face; no invented gym testimonial or transformation. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice.

beats.script: I almost kept scrolling. I'd tried the celery juice thing back in 2019 and felt absolutely nothing.
beats.visual: Skeptical recollection; slight head tilt on 2019.
beats.emotion: Objection — voice the viewer’s skepticism.
beats.note: Hold I almost kept scrolling and prior celery-juice experience. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice.

beats.script: But she said it doesn't work that way on its own. You need all three together in the right ratio or you're just guessing.
beats.visual: Continue the reply in her own conversational voice.
beats.emotion: Answer — keep the stated distinction clear.
beats.note: Hold on all three together; no formula ratio numbers added. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Aligned to selected ElevenLabs voice.
